penalties.details: Notice for non-compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
penalties.impact: The request for waiver was not considered favourably by NSE vide its letter dated February 16, 2026. Consequently, the Company has duly paid the fine amounting to Rs. 10,000/- plus applicable tax to NSE on February 20, 2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Failure to meet the benchmark of the Quality-of-Service parameters in Mumbai service area for the quarter ending June 2025 under Standards of Quality of Service of Access (Wireline and Wireless) and Broadband (Wireline and Wireless) Service Regulations, 2024. The Company is reviewing the financial disincentive order and evaluating the next steps in this matter.
tax_litigation.status: TTML has made payment in lieu of the same on February 17, 2025.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Failure to curb the Unsolicited Commercial Communications (UCC) sent through Company’s network for the complaints as required under the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations, 2018, for the Quarter ending March 2024. The Company is reviewing the Order and evaluating the next steps in this matter.
tax_litigation.status: TTL has filed its representation against the order on March 31, 2026 and has also preferred TP No. 219/2026 against the said Financial Disincentive Order. The matter was listed on April 6, 2026 and was adjourned to April 7, 2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Failure to curb the Unsolicited Commercial Communications (UCC) sent through Company’s network for the complaints as required under the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations, 2018, for the Quarter ending June 2024. The Company is reviewing the Order and evaluating the next steps in this matter.
tax_litigation.status: TTML has, under protest and without prejudice to its rights and submissions in the matter, remitted the entire Financial Disincentive amount of Rs. 64,000/ vis a vis TTML on 22.05.2026 through NEFT, in accordance with the instructions contained in the aforesaid Financial Disincentive Order.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: In terms of the TRAI Regulations, the Company is required to meet the QoS benchmarks for the broadband service in respect of each parameter specified under the Standards of Quality of Service of Access (Wireline and Wireless) and Broadband (Wireline and Wireless) Service Regulations, 2024 (06 of 2024) for Broadband (Wireline) Service for the quarter ending June, 2025. The financial disincentive of Rs. 2,00,000/- is imposed for alleged failure to comply with the QoS parameters for Broadband Services - “Fault incidences (No. of faults per 100 subscribers) (= 5)” and parameter “Fault repair within three working days (= 99%)” for Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited were allegedly not met. The Company is reviewing the Order and evaluating the next steps in this matter.
tax_litigation.status: TTML made without prejudice payment of Rs. 2,00,000/- against the aforesaid Financial Disincentive order on 29.06.2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Alleged irregular or ineligible availment of Cenvat Credit during the financial years: 2009 - 10 to 2011 – 12. The Company does not agree with the Order and will take appropriate action(s) for the same.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Commissioner, CGST & Central Excise Commissionerate, Belapur
tax_litigation.status: Appeal proposed to be filed by 23.09.2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Imposition of Penalty of Rs. 50,000/- for non-maintenance of the utility chamber on municipal road
tax_litigation.status: TTML’s managed service partner M/s Telecrats has held meeting with the BMC officials and provided clarifications. While the matter is reportedly settled, there has been no further communication from BMC with respect to the show cause notice.

timeline.summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited’s 31st AGM held on June 5, 2026, chaired by **A. S. Lakshminarayanan**, passed all resolutions with requisite majority via video conferencing.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹309.65 Cr (+8.2% YoY), net loss ₹59.2 Cr (against a loss of ₹320.82 Cr a year earlier).
TRAI levied a ₹1.02 lakh financial disincentive on Tata Teleservices for failing to curb unsolicited commercial communications in Q3FY25.
